texts.value: Glucose 1,6-bisphosphate synthase using 1,3-bisphosphoglycerate as a phosphate donor and a series of 1-phosphate sugars, including glucose 1-phosphate, mannose 1-phosphate, ribose 1-phosphate and deoxyribose 1-phosphate, as acceptors (PubMed:17804405). disease.diseaseId: Neurodevelopmental disorder with hypotonia, dysmorphic facies, and skin abnormalities
disease.description: An autosomal recessive neurodevelopmental disorder characterized by severe developmental and speech delay, dysmorphic facial features, ear anomalies, high arched palate, strabismus, hypotonia, and keratosis pilaris. Early obesity and seizures may be present in affected individuals.
